title: ynf.failure.v1
description: The data of an episodic memory ynf writes for each occurrence of a failure signature (ADR-008). Its subject is the signature, so ynm's consolidation clusters the same failure across items; each occurrence's text names its item, run, step and time, so consolidation never takes two occurrences for one fact. It is tagged ynf.failure.v1, which is how to select it: ynm filters by tag, not by dataSchema.

count.description: Times this signature has occurred on this item.

run_id.description: The run whose outcome produced it, when there was one.

model.description: The model of the step's run, when the runner reported one.
